description.sub_name: 證券交易法理論與實務
description.sub_ename: THE THEORY AND PRACTICE OF SECURITIES LAW
description.describe_ch: 開設對象為於公民營機構服務之在職班學生。證券交易相關規範對企業經營、財務管理，以及理財投資相當重要，本課程以案例分析為主要教學方法，藉以講解證券交易規範內容、主要爭議以及在實務上的適用。
description.describe_eh: This course is designed for professionals working in the industry and public sector. The laws and regulations concerning securities exchange are very important to business operations, financial management and asset investment. This course uses case analysis as the main teaching method to explain the regulatory content, important disputes, and practical application of securities exchange regulation.
